attr.title: ProjectKagemaru (Virtua Fighter)
attr.desc: Native ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 handheld port of vf1-recomp (Sega Model 1 static recompilation for Virtua Fighter) with on-device SLJIT ARM64 V60 recompilation, 3:2 widescreen support, 60fps smooth motion, decoupled 68000+MultiPCM sound core, and secrets/cheats. Engineered for Anbernic RG34XX (Allwinner H700 / Mali-G31).
attr.inst:
1. Copy your own legal MAME vf.zip (with 315-5724.bin) into ports/projectkagemaru/roms/vf.zip (optionally also model1io.zip).
2. Launch Virtua Fighter.sh — SLJIT recompiles the NEC V60 program to native ARM64 automatically on startup (no PC pre-build required!).
3. Press Start+Select (or Menu) in-game for Display, Audio, Secrets (Siba/Jeff/Takeru/Koskol/Dural), Random Fighters, Fight Switches, and Controls.
